subject: Re: Dedicated capacity demo — HorizonAI throughput & latency needs
messages:
From: Alex Brown <alex.brown@horizonai.com>
To: support@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request — Dedicated capacity for low-latency/throughput use case

Hi Redwood team,

We just completed a self-serve trial of the API and are very impressed with throughput but want to explore a Dedicated capacity setup for production. We have a latency SLO of 50ms p95 and expect sustained 200 req/s for short bursts up to 1k req/s.

Can we schedule a technical demo focused on:
- expected per-token latency on dedicated GPU pools
- autoscaling and burst behavior
- KV/prefix caching and how it affects cold-starts
- regional failover and SLOs

Attaching a short requirements sheet. Our team: myself (platform lead) and Samantha Lee (ML infra).

Thanks,
Alex Brown
Platform Lead, HorizonAI
Attachment: HorizonAI_throughput_requirements.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Brown <alex.brown@horizonai.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — Dedicated capacity for low-latency/throughput use case

Hi Alex — great to hear you tried the self-serve flow and that it went well. I'm Marissa on the SDR team; happy to get a demo set up.

Quick Qs before we book so we route the right folks:
- Is the 50ms p95 requirement for text generation (end-to-end) or for embedding/other calls?
- Are those 200 req/s sustained single-user bursts or aggregate across many clients?
- Any compliance constraints (VPC/on-prem) we should be aware of?

Availability this week for a 45–60m technical session:
• Tue 30 Jun — 10:00–11:00 PT or 14:00–15:00 PT
• Wed 1 Jul — 09:00–11:00 PT

I'll loop in Aditya (AE) and Dev (solutions engineer) to cover architecture and deployment patterns.

Best,
Marissa Cole
SDR, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Alex Brown <alex.brown@horizonai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@horizonai.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — Dedicated capacity for low-latency/throughput use case

Thanks Marissa — answers inline: 
- 50ms p95 is for end-to-end text generation calls (90–512 tokens typical).
- 200 req/s is sustained aggregate across our production cluster; spikes up to 1k req/s for a few minutes during peak events.
- We need SOC2-level controls; VPC peering is preferred but not mandatory at this stage.

Either Tue 30 Jun 10:00 PT or Wed 1 Jul 09:00 PT works — prefer Tue if you can.

I've attached an SLO workbook with example traffic profile.

Alex
Attachment: HorizonAI_SLOs.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Brown <alex.brown@horizonai.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — Dedicated capacity for low-latency/throughput use case

Perfect — thanks for the details, Alex. Looping in Aditya (AE) and Dev (solutions eng) to lead the technical portion.

Aditya / Dev — HorizonAI is evaluating Dedicated capacity for a latency-sensitive production workload. Key requirements: 50ms p95 end-to-end for generation (90–512 tokens), sustained ~200 req/s with spikes to 1k req/s. They prefer VPC peering and SOC2 controls.

Can you take Tue 30 Jun 10:00–10:45 PT for a technical demo + Q&A? Proposed agenda:
1) Quick intros and current self-serve findings (5m)
2) Redwood Dedicated architecture and kernel/runtime optimizations for low latency (10m)
3) Throughput testing and autoscaling behavior (15m)
4) Caching, warmup, and KV strategies to meet p95 SLOs (10m)
5) Integrations (VPC, KMS) + next steps (5m)

I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Alex Brown <alex.brown@horizonai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — Dedicated capacity demo confirmation

Hi Alex — thanks for the context and the SLO workbook. Tue 30 Jun 10:00 PT works for me and Dev; we'll plan for ~45 minutes.

A few notes so we can tailor the demo:
- We'll run a short live throughput demo using a dedicated pool profile similar to your expected CPU/GPU mix and show p50/p95/p99 latency.
- We'll share baseline numbers for cold-start vs steady-state and talk through KV cache strategies to reduce tail latency.
- We'll also show autoscaler behavior and how burst capacity is handled (including fallback to hosted variants if desired).

I'll attach the draft invite + agenda and include a Zoom link. If you want us to run any custom traces, please share a small sample traffic profile (anonymized) before the call.

Looking forward — Aditya
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_dedicated_demo_invite.ics
